- Gender: Transgender woman
- Background: Mid-size city living; Lives alone; Works remote tech; Consistent therapy/meds; Limited close friendships

- Current Suicide Risk Level: None (no current or recent passive or active suicidal thoughts; may express psychological risk factors such as hopelessness or feelings of burdensomeness; no history of suicidal behavior)
- Current Suicidal Thoughts and Behaviors: No suicidal ideation and no psychological risk factors for suicidal ideation (e.g., hopelessness, burdensomeness, intense emotional suffering)
- Disclosure of Suicide Risk: Not applicable
- Diagnoses and Symptoms: Neurocognitive / executive symptoms (attention difficulties, impulsivity, disorganization, ADHD-related challenges, emotion regulation difficulties)

- Mental Health Stigma: Low (mental health and suicide seen as legitimate and discussable; little shame; help-seeking acceptable)
- Financial Stress: Low (financially stable; little to no meaningful money-related stress)
- Social Isolation: High (e.g., no reliable confidants or only superficial contact; rarely or never shares personal struggles; limited meaningful social interaction)
- Discrimination Exposure: None (no reported experiences of discrimination affecting mental health or wellbeing)
- Recent Triggers and Stressors: Missed medication refill; Apartment feels quiet; Work deadline pileup; Sleep schedule drift
- Primary Communication Style: Disorganized (fragmented, uneven, rapid shifts)
- Reaction to provider Responses: Engaged (builds on or seeks clarification of suggestions)
